mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and, subsequently, positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic output.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing HOUST and RSAFS signals robust demand in both housing and retail sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate broad economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with jointly increasing HOUST and RSAFS, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS, indicating inflation outpacing monetary policy, S&P 500 forward returns are predicted to be negative over the next 20 trading days due to decreased purchasing power.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL growth outpaces FEDFUNDS 3-month MA, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in PAYEMS below its 6-month moving average, signaling weakening labor market conditions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate decreased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS < 6-month MA, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of increasing INDPRO and decreasing UNRATE signals a supply-side driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate efficient economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in supply-side driven periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).
